messages:
maria-cs: Quick alert: onboarding delays for tenants created during last night's EU index migration. ~15 tenants impacted (mostly trials, 3 high-touch). Need comms + localization + credit proposal.

sam-eng: Investigating, added indexer capacity and relaxed retry policy. Queue depth dropping. ETA ~30-40m for catch-up.

ashley-se: Please DM the list and a 1-line RCA for customers. We should offer a clear remediation and next steps.

maria-cs: DM sent. RCA: indexer backlog + aggressive retry hitting a rate limiter during migration traffic.

neil-ops: Rolled limiter config at 17:18 UTC, backfill started. 9/15 tenants done, 6 still catching up.

john-vp-cs: Recommend offer: 2 weeks credits + 1:1 office hours for high-touch; 1 week credits + recorded office hours for trials. Prioritized manual import if needed.

lina-localization: I can localize FR/DE/ES. Send final subject+body and I'll return translations in ~20m.

incident-bot: INC-2026-042 logged: "EU migration onboarding delay" severity=S2 owners=maria-cs,sam-eng,neil-ops.

maria-cs: Draft outbound (short): apology, what we did, credits offered, how to get help. I'll send individualized notes to high-touch within 45m and bulk localized note to trials after translations. Will post RCA in ~24h.
